what_it_shows: Drone flight over the Lighthouse Marina Resort in bright sun: the white lighthouse, the resort building with its pool, and the bay behind.
notes: YouTube channel 'lighthousesubic' (name matches the resort; not verified as official). Source is 640x480, so the 720-wide cut is soft. A rotor blade crosses the frame around 13s, so the cut starts at 16s. No text or logo in the 16-23s window.
